name_input: SFS Group India Private Limited; SFS Group India Private Limited; SFS Group India Private Limited; SFS GROUP INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for SFS GROUP INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (Gat No. 387/389, Village Urawade, Tal-Mulashi) states 'Total Shipments 11208 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 142', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28'. However every one of the 5 dated rows actually displayed is an INBOUND movement into India, e.g. '2026-02-28 | SFS GROUP INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | CUMMINS JUAREZ FUEL SYSTEM, P038000011BA0300 6561000 (BARREL INJECTOR)- | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Los Angeles, UNITED STATES | 84099990 | BOL 1125962' and '2026-02-27 | CANNON INDUSTRIES, INC | SFS GROUP INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | 3076033 GUIDE BALL | NEW YORK, UNITED STATES | SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | 83021090 | BOL 7789835'. Top ports listed are all Indian import gateways (SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 654, NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 305). No outbound shipment row with an Indian port of loading, foreign destination and B/L number was visible. Source counter: page claims 11,208 shipments; rows actually seen = 5, all imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split was retrieved. The only address evidence is the registered/plant address in the ImportKey header: 'GAT NO. 387/389, VILLAGE URAWADE TAL-MULASHI'. No domestic supply record confirmed.
note: Legal-entity mismatch: the batch claims legal name 'INDO SCHOTTLE AUTO PARTS PVT LTD', but the shipment records are under 'SFS GROUP INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED'. A separate ImportKey page exists for slug 'indo-schottle-auto-parts-pvt-ltd' but it renders 'Loading...' with zero shipment rows, suppliers or buyers — i.e. no trade records found under that name. The two names are therefore not linked by any public shipment record I could see; the claimed legal name is unverified. HS 870870 (wheels/parts) declared in the batch does not match the HS codes actually observed on the records (84099990 engine parts, 83021090 hinges/mountings) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the factual code should be corrected. Export direction: the 11,208-record counter is a platform total that mixes import and export; the visible sample is 100% import, so actual outbound shipments are 'declared, not confirmed'. Domestic supply: no evidence found either way — not 'conditionally accepted', simply no trace located. Note also that the 2026-02-28 latest-cargo date is in the future relative to a normal verification date, so the dataset's freshness should be treated with caution. Volza, Eximpedia and Trademo free views returned HTTP 403 and could not be used as second sources; DuckDuckGo search was unavailable during this run.
